rules.description: [Mix] Apple keyboards only: Fn+Left/Right act as Home/End, same behavior as the PC-Style Home/End rule (Fn+Ctrl = start/end of document)
[Mix] Terminals: Linux-style Ctrl+Shift+C/V (copy/paste) and N/W/F (new window/close/find)
[Mix] Finder: F2 rename, Delete = Move to Trash, Alt+Enter = Get Info, Alt+Up/Left/Right = up/back/forward, Ctrl+L = Go to Folder
[Mix] Win+Tab = Mission Control (Task View), Win+D = Show Desktop (needs the default F11 Show Desktop shortcut)

[AP] Missing PC Shortcuts

◦ Chrome - ctrl+h, ctrl+shift+7-9
◦ VSCode Shortcuts - ctrl+r (as-is), ctrl+shift+up/down, ctrl+/, ctrl+end, ctrl+home, ctrl+shift+]/[, ctrl+shift+t, ctrl*+p, ctrl*+d, ctrl+,, go back in VSCode - alt+left_arrow
◦ Windows Shortcuts: cmd+shift+s for screenshot, cmd+f4
◦ Mouse Related (you need to enable mouse via the devices screen): ctrl+click -> cmd+click
◦ Iterm2: ctrl(shift)+<arrows>, command+arrows, ctrl/cmd+delete/bkpc, shift+home/end, atrl+a (select all pwsh), ctrl+v (paste only)
PC-Style Screenshot to File (PrintScreen to select)
